step.label: Initiate engineering change request
step.description: Capture and validate new product specifications and engineering modifications for market introduction.
step.useCase: Operations manager submits engineering change order for new product variant with material updates

step.label: Coordinate design review and compliance gate
step.description: Conduct cross-functional design review to ensure compliance standards before proceeding to BOM validation.
step.useCase: PLM team reviews design against engineering standards and involves workforce for feasibility assessment

step.label: Validate bill of materials compliance
step.description: Verify that all product components and materials comply with approved specifications and regulatory requirements.
step.useCase: Supply chain manager ensures all materials in product structure meet compliance rules before manufacturing

step.label: Assess hazardous substance risk
step.description: Evaluate potential safety and regulatory risks associated with materials and substances in the product.
step.useCase: Safety officer identifies hazardous substance handling requirements and regulatory obligations

step.label: Coordinate occupational safety incident protocols
step.description: Establish safety procedures and incident response protocols for manufacturing and handling identified hazards.
step.useCase: Safety manager documents incident prevention measures and worker notification procedures

step.label: Validate workforce capacity and availability
step.description: Confirm adequate staffing, skills, and production capacity to execute the product launch timeline.
step.useCase: Production scheduler confirms team availability and training completion for new production line

step.label: Authorize campaign and customer access
step.description: Grant controlled access permissions for marketing campaign and customer account updates to enable product launch.
step.useCase: Marketing director activates go-live permissions for sales teams and campaign channels

step.label: Enrich customer order and fulfill launch
step.description: Update customer account records with new product offerings and enable order acceptance for market release.
step.useCase: Sales enablement team publishes new product to customer accounts and processes initial orders
